title: Speed benchmark: 70-story shear-wall tower
purpose: A 70-story tower, 840 ft tall: a 40 x 40 ft core of four 2 ft concrete shear walls meshed 2.5 x 3 ft (17,920 wall shells), 24 columns of 3 ft and beams on a 120 x 120 ft plan, a rigid diaphragm at every floor. Linear only: self-weight, superimposed load on the beams, lateral load (1.3 kips x level number, about 2% of the weight) and 12 modes, timed in both programs on the same PC, ETABS on its advanced solver with all cores.

settings.selfWeight: 0.150 kcf on columns, beams and walls
settings.endOffsets: off (ETABS automatic end length offsets disabled, forces reported joint to joint)
settings.solver: ETABS advanced solver, all cores; SkyFrame default (PARDISO when installed)
